articles.author: Financial Desk
articles.title: JPMorgan Chase expands corporate credit facility amidst tightening commercial liquidity
articles.description: JPMorgan Chase announced an expanded syndicated loan framework to assist large corporate clients navigating higher borrowing rates.
articles.content: JPMorgan Chase reported that its wholesale banking division has syndicated over $15B in multi-currency credit lines.

articles.author: Maritime Logistics Bureau
articles.title: Maersk reroutes container vessels via Cape of Good Hope following Red Sea security alert
articles.description: A.P. Moller - Maersk has instructed all merchant vessels to avoid Bab el-Mandeb strait due to heightened drone and missile risks, adding 12 days to transit times.
articles.content: Shipping giant Maersk announced severe schedule adjustments as freight rates on Asia-Europe corridors surged 40%.

articles.author: Tech & Energy Reporting
articles.title: ExxonMobil and Chevron report record upstream cash flows while refining margins soften
articles.description: US energy majors ExxonMobil and Chevron posted resilient quarterly upstream earnings, offsetting softer retail fuel margins.
articles.content: ExxonMobil CEO highlighted strong Permian basin output while keeping capital expenditure guidance disciplined.

articles.author: Semiconductor Analysis
articles.title: NVIDIA and TSMC accelerate Blackwell Ultra AI processor volume production
articles.description: TSMC confirmed full capacity utilization on advanced 3nm packaging lines dedicated to NVIDIA's next-generation data center accelerators.
articles.content: Strong demand from hyperscalers including Microsoft and Google ensures high backlogs into 2027.

articles.author: Banking Bureau
articles.title: HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank report stable asset quality with retail credit expansion
articles.description: Leading Indian private lenders HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank posted resilient loan growth and stable gross non-performing asset ratios for the fiscal quarter.
articles.content: HDFC Bank credit book expanded by 14% year-on-year, supported by strong urban consumer and wholesale corporate demand.
